name: Rad Balek 1.0.1 — reliability fixes
body:
A full audit of the alert-delivery path found cases where an alert could fail to ring. All fixed and verified.

**Alerts that reached nobody**
- Cold/Snow and uncommon-hazard red alerts were published to topics with zero subscribers
- A rotated FCM token (phone restore, reinstall) left a device permanently unsubscribed; subscriptions now self-heal on launch
- A slow first launch could disable subscriptions for the whole session
- Safety guidance fell back to heat-wave advice for other hazards

**Siren**
- The siren could be left looping with no way to stop it
- A red alert in Do Not Disturb could display silently
- "Call 14" now stops the siren so the caller can be heard
- The 3-hourly still-active reminder no longer re-fires the full siren

**Server-side (already live)**
- A momentary ONM outage could announce "alert over" during a live red alert
- Offshore earthquakes produced no red alert at all
- A FIRMS column change could drop every satellite fire and poison the fallback cache
- Admin moderation endpoint is now rate-limited

Not an official government service. In an emergency, call Protection Civile: 14 or 1021.

APK: app-release.apk (universal, all devices).
